summary: The core fix from #710 (60633eff3) is in place and the Hub's vendored Ryco (7bc39eec3) includes it. Statistics, Pull requests and Projects use lazyRouteComponent. The router sets defaultPreload "intent" with a 50 ms delay. Statistics and PRs have loaders that start their data in parallel with the chunk. The boot-logo fallback is now a blank RoutePagePending shell that appears only after 300 ms. I checked the PR loader's cause/preloadStaleTime handling against router-core 1.171.28: with preloadStaleTime 0, a hovered match reloads on navigation with cause "enter", so the prefetch runs. The auditor's "no fix defects" is wrong in one small way. #709 (56fbe263a, merged after #710) added a third Statistics view, "limits", and prefetchStatisticsPage still sends every non-usage view to the else branch. So entering /statistics?view=limits, or switching to the Limits tab, starts a getStatistics activity snapshot that the Limits view never uses. The Limits view's own data (readCliProxyHubs) is not prefetched, so that view still loads its chunk first and its data after mount. Two common entry points reach it: the composer's ContextWindowMeter "All accounts" button and the CLIProxyAPI settings link. The optional proposal 5 (idle chunk preload for these pages) is also not done.

evidence.note: loaderDeps plus a fire-and-forget loader that imports statisticsPrefetch; component is lazyRouteComponent(StatisticsRouteView); pendingComponent RoutePagePending, pendingMs 300.

Loader prefetches lists only when cause === "enter". preloadStaleTime: 0 makes navigation after a hover reload the match (router-core load-client.ts:789-802 uses preloadStaleTime for match.preload and reloads when match.cause === 'enter'), so the prefetch does run on click.
lazyRouteComponent plus RoutePagePending; no loader (proposal 3 did not ask for one for Projects).
Blank SidebarInset after 300 ms replaces AppBootLoadingSurface. AppBootLoadingSurface remains only in __root.tsx, hostedRootAppShell.tsx and native.authorize.

DEFECT: only the "usage" branch is special-cased. Every other view, including "limits" added by #709, falls through to prefetchStatistics() (getStatistics). The test (statisticsPrefetch.test.ts) covers only usage and activity.
The limits view uses WS_METHODS.serverReadCliProxyHubs and renders LimitsView, which never calls useStatistics, so the prefetched snapshot is unused for that view.
loaderDeps returns { view } for limits, so each switch to the Limits tab reruns the loader and fires another unused getStatistics, at most once per 30 s (SharedRequests handoff window).
The composer's "All accounts" button navigates to /statistics?view=limits; CliProxyHubSettings.tsx:139-145 does the same. These are the common entry points that hit the defect.
Limits data is read in an effect after mount via connection.client.server.readCliProxyHubs. There is no prefetch hook, so the chunk-then-data waterfall remains for this view.
ShellIdlePreloads warms the thread and draft routes, the command palette and settings. It does not warm the Statistics, Projects or PR chunks (optional proposal 5 not done).
Prefetch handoff and join semantics are sound: a hover followed by a click within 30 s asks once, and superseded joined flights can still be aborted.

remaining: Core finding resolved. Leftovers: (1) Defect: statisticsPrefetch.ts:17-25 starts an unused getStatistics for view=limits, and the Limits view's readCliProxyHubs is not prefetched (useCliProxyHubs.ts:94-110). (2) Optional proposal 5: no idle preload of the /statistics, /projects and /pull-requests chunks in ShellIdlePreloads (RootAppShell.tsx:177-185). (3) Minor: imperative entry points (CommandPaletteDialog.tsx:1598/1612/1693, ContextWindowMeter, ProjectBar menus, inbox rows) get no hover chunk warm-up. Their navigations still run the chunk and loader in parallel with no logo flash.
fixDefects: prefetchStatisticsPage (apps/web/src/components/statistics/statisticsPrefetch.ts:17-25) was written when StatisticsView was only "usage" | "activity". After #709 added "limits", the else branch fires prefetchStatistics() (a server getStatistics snapshot, sent over the relay in hosted mode) every time someone enters or switches to the Limits view (loaderDeps { view } at routes/statistics.tsx:36). No component joins it unless the user then opens Activity within 30 s. Meanwhile the Limits view's real request (readCliProxyHubs) still starts only after the chunk mounts. Impact is low: the server query is incremental and the request is deduped per 30 s. But it is wasted work, and the statisticsPrefetch tests do not cover the third view.
implementationSketch: 1) apps/web/src/components/statistics/statisticsPrefetch.ts: replace the if/else with an exhaustive switch on search.view: case "usage" keeps the current capability check and prefetchUsageSummary; case "activity" keeps the getStatistics check and prefetchStatistics(); case "limits" returns, or prefetches hubs as in step 2. Add a `const unreachable: never = search.view` default so a future view breaks typecheck. Add a test to statisticsPrefetch.test.ts: with both capabilities allowed, prefetchStatisticsPage({view:"limits",...}) calls neither prefetchStatistics nor prefetchUsageSummary. 2) Optional, to remove the Limits waterfall: in apps/web/src/components/statistics/limits/useCliProxyHubs.ts, move the per-environment non-refresh readCliProxyHubs call into a module-level SharedRequests<CliProxyEnvironmentResult> (from @ryco/client-runtime/usage) keyed by environmentId. Export prefetchCliProxyHubs(environmentIds) that uses selectConnections(listEnvironmentConnections(), ids) and skips nodes whose serverConfig lacks capabilities.cliProxyHubs. In load(), call requests.request(key, ...) with fresh: forceNextRef.current. Call it from the "limits" branch after readHostedRpcCapability(WS_METHODS.serverReadCliProxyHubs).allowed. Extend LimitsView.browser.tsx so a prefetched read is joined and not repeated. 3) Optional proposal 5: in RootAppShell.tsx ShellIdlePreloads, add a final idle task that calls void preloadRouteChunk("/statistics") and void preloadRouteChunk("/projects"). Optionally add "/pull-requests" last (about 311 KiB gzip) and gate it on !isHostedHubMode() to keep hosted bandwidth down. scheduleShellIdlePreloads already skips constrained networks and the phone tier. Validate with the focused vitest for statisticsPrefetch and the statistics/limits browser tests only.
decisionReason: Local web-only change to a client prefetch helper. No auth, E2EE, hosted lifecycle or Hub protocol impact. Whether to idle-preload the PR chunk on hosted is a minor bandwidth choice that does not need a formal decision.
correction: The auditor reported no fix defects. In fact the Statistics route prefetch does not handle the "limits" view added by #709 after #710: it fires an unused getStatistics on every Limits entry or tab switch and leaves the Limits data in the chunk-then-data waterfall. The DONE status still holds for the pages and views in the finding's original scope.
